Bring a running Delta Manager career up to date with the newest version of a Workshop mod, without losing your progress.

## Install and use
1. Download **DM-Save-Update.exe** below (no installation, no Python needed).
2. **Chrome or Edge blocks the download?** Open the downloads list (`Ctrl+J`) and choose **Keep**. The program is new and not signed, so browsers do not know it yet.
3. **Windows protected your PC?** Click **More info → Run anyway**.
4. The tool finds your Delta Manager save folder and Workshop folder by itself. Choose the **mod** and your **save**, press **Show changes**.
5. Close Delta Manager (or go back to its main menu), press **Apply update** and confirm. A backup is made in the save folder first; **Restore backup…** puts it back.

Only mod settings are updated: category rules, circuits and the sponsor pool. Drivers, teams, staff, contracts, results and history are never touched. Rules changed by era votes in your career keep their voted value.

Something looks wrong? Press **Save report…** and post the report on the Delta Manager Discord or open an issue here.
